entries.happened: A project's automation closed a pull request because it referenced no existing issue.
entries.change: The policy scan reads a project's pull-request automation as well as its contributing guide, and the release gate checks a required issue reference before a pull request is opened.

entries.happened: Another contributor opened the same fix shortly before the factory did.
entries.change: A fix is prepared before its issue is opened, and the pull request follows promptly, with a collision check after the push. Where a project wants discussion or a maintainer's answer first, the issue goes first and the factory waits. Since 2026-11-10, bug reports younger than 48 hours are left alone unless a maintainer invites a pull request.
entries.moves: Closed: someone else fixed it first

entries.happened: A fix patched the callers of a shared layer. The maintainer fixed the layer instead and kept the regression test.
entries.change: Review answers whether the change sits in the layer that owns the contract.
entries.moves: Closed: the maintainer fixed it another way

entries.happened: A fix was right, but its generated test matrix was not how the project tests. It was changed on request and then merged.
entries.change: Each project's conventions are written on a note for that project, its repository card, which the implementer receives with the task.

entries.happened: A maintainer closed a fix as a non-real issue: the input came from the factory probing the code, not from any project. Two later closures also cited the lack of a real-world case.
entries.change: A candidate names who hits the problem, with a source, and a failure path needs a real report or captured output. Since 2026-11-10 a separate agent decides build, propose or drop before any code is written.

entries.happened: First pull requests to new projects were going unanswered. By 2026-11-20 twelve projects had received one pull request each and merged none, and eight of those were still open with no reply from a person.
entries.change: Before a first pull request, the factory samples whether outsiders' pull requests get a human review within three days, unless a maintainer invited the work. Silent projects are stopped and not pinged.
entries.moves: Still open: no reply from a person

entries.happened: On a fix that was never published, the author's checks passed and two rounds of independent review each found a different regression. The record is private; the link is the issue the fix was for.
entries.change: Review answers a fixed list of ways earlier changes failed (risk classes), each with a signed record of the command that checked it. After a second failed round the agent session running the shift takes the item over or shelves it; this item was shelved on 2026-11-11.

entries.happened: Until this date the factory said its work was AI-written only where a project asked: 25 of the 129 pull-request descriptions carry such a statement and the other 104 carry none. A statement made only in a comment, as on postcss#2182, is not counted.
entries.change: New pull requests say they are automated and link to this repository. Projects that ban or restrict AI-generated contributions are not candidates.
